model_snapshot.claim: No immutable snapshot claim is made.

external_instruction_control.rule: Use the same launcher, system/developer instruction set, tool policy, working directory policy, and task presentation for every trial.
external_instruction_control.digest_requirement: Bind every model-visible instruction byte exposed to the runner in the prelaunch manifest; if provider-owned instructions remain unexposed, record that limitation rather than claiming byte identity.

prelaunch_verification: Re-run codex --version and require 0.149.1 unless a fresh human-authorized contract supersedes this one.
Resolve the effective model designation and require gpt-5.6-sol.
Resolve reasoning effort and require medium.
Verify Standard service rather than Fast mode.
Record every model, backend, deployment, service, and app-server identifier exposed by initialization and the first receipt.
Record temperature, top_p, seed, and snapshot as values only when the execution surface exposes them; otherwise retain not_exposed.
Verify tools are disabled and each trial starts in a fresh context.
Record weekly-usage meter value and timestamp immediately before T001.
boundary_stop: Stop on any known model designation, reasoning, service-tier, client-version, tool-policy, or exposed-backend transition. Comparisons crossing that boundary are invalid.
